name: Adhesive Capsulitis / Frozen Shoulder
definition: Painful shoulder disorder with marked restriction of both active and passive glenohumeral movement, especially external rotation, often evolving through painful, stiff and recovery phases.

typical: Gradual shoulder pain and night pain
Diabetes and thyroid disease increase risk

core: Compare active and passive range of motion

investigations.principle: Diagnosis is usually clinical after excluding major mimics.
investigations.MRI: MRI is not routine; use when alternative pathology is suspected.
investigations.radiographs: Plain radiograph can exclude arthritis or other bony disease when needed.

amber: Intra-articular corticosteroid, hydrodilatation, manipulation or arthroscopic release require individualized phase/severity assessment.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Avabahuka is a commonly considered correlation; modern capsular restriction and exclusion of mimics remain essential.

patientEducation.summary: Painful shoulder disorder with marked restriction of both active and passive glenohumeral movement, especially external rotation, often evolving through painful, stiff and recovery phases.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for new/progressive major weakness, gait deterioration, bladder/bowel dysfunction, saddle sensory loss, fever/systemic illness with severe spinal/joint pain, major trauma, or other listed red flags.
